# sfcompute_firewalls (Data Source)

Reads firewalls from SF Compute (`GET /preview/v2/firewalls`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `workspace` (String) Workspace to list firewalls in. If omitted, the provider's `workspace` is used.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `has_more` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `owner` (String)
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a firewall resource. Format: sfc:firewall:<account>:<workspace>:<name>.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Allow-only ingress rules. Order is preserved across reads and PUT replacements. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--rules))
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `workspace` (String)
- `workspace_id` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--data--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.rules`

Read-Only:

- `direction` (String) Direction of a firewall rule. Only `ingress` is accepted today; `egress` is reserved for future use and rejected with 422 if submitted.
- `port` (String) Required for tcp/udp; must be absent on icmp.
- `protocol` (String)
- `source` (String) IPv4 source CIDR. Defaults to `0.0.0.0/0` (allow from any address) when omitted on input. Cannot overlap non-publicly-routable space (private, loopback, link-local, CGNAT, documentation, multicast, etc.); the wildcard `0.0.0.0/0` is the only exception.
